AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Universal Installer is a package installer and app management utility for Android supporting APK, APKS, XAPK, and APKM packages. Operational Patterns: - Use 'searchInstalledApps' to find installed apps by name or package name before calling 'getInstalledAppDetails' or 'openUninstallDialog'. - Use 'getRecentInstallHistory' and 'getRecentUninstallLogs' to inspect recent package installation and uninstallation outcomes. - Use 'getInstallerStats' to retrieve lifetime installation, uninstallation, storage, and security scan statistics. - Use 'scanDeviceForPackageFiles' to discover installable APK, APKS, XAPK, and APKM files on device storage. - Use 'openAppScreen' or 'openUninstallDialog' to return a PendingIntent when the user wants to navigate into a specific screen or confirm uninstalling an app. Constraints: - Package installation and uninstallation always require explicit user confirmation in the UI; functions never silently install or remove apps.
